cap.untrusted: In Restricted Mode TaskKeeper only shows your tasks and runs; creating or running tasks requires a trusted workspace, because a task runs an agent on that repository.
cap.virtual: TaskKeeper needs a real Git repository on disk to create isolated worktrees.
welcome.inbox:
Nothing waiting for you.

When a scheduled task finishes, its result appears here with the diff, the tests and two buttons: accept into your branch or throw it away.

[New task](command:taskkeeper.newTask)
welcome.tasks:
No tasks yet.

A task runs Claude Code or Codex on a schedule, inside its own Git worktree, so your repository is never touched until you review.

[New task](command:taskkeeper.newTask)
cmd.setConcurrency: Set Concurrent Runs on This Machine
cfg.dataDir: Folder where TaskKeeper keeps its local database, worktrees and logs. Leave empty for the default (`%APPDATA%\Argalla\TaskKeeper` on Windows).
cfg.defaultTimezone: IANA time zone offered by default when creating a task (for example `Europe/Madrid`). Empty uses the system time zone.
cfg.notifications: Show a notification when a run finishes, fails or is waiting for your review.
